text: First, additional files including data sets specific census data Blantyre added package https://data.humdata.org. fictional article use spatial data therefore, data read simple features using sf-package can see following code chunk.
code: # read in ward boundaries data census_boundaries <-    st_read(here::here("vignettes", "articles",                      "traditional-authorities", "Malawi_TA_2018.shp")) |>    st_as_sf()  # read in traditional authority population data census_data <- read_csv(here::here("vignettes", "articles",                                     "traditional-authorities",                                     "census_data.csv"))  # read the skip locations with coordinates into a simple feature # (spatial vector data) and set the coordinate reference system equal to # the one from census_boundaries sf_skips <- skips |>    filter(!is.na(x), !is.na(y)) |>    st_as_sf(coords = c("x", "y"), crs = 4326) |>    st_transform(st_crs(census_boundaries))  # wards of Blantyre City wards <- census_boundaries |>    filter(DIST_NAME == "Blantyre City")

title: skips: Public waste skip locations in Blantyre, Malawi — skips
text: Public waste skip locations Blantyre, Malawi, 2023 update dataset. row skip location names, cleansing supervision area, surrounding context, vehicle access, number skips fill-times reported people surveyed. dataset replaces wasteskipsblantyre (53 skip locations collected 2021).

title: skips: Public waste skip locations in Blantyre, Malawi — skips
skips: Public waste skip locations in Blantyre, Malawi — skips
text: tibble 67 rows 13 variables. Rows 48 67 (20 rows) name, location values; carry constant capacity value (see https://github.com/openwashdata/wasteskipsblantyre/issues/11). 4 named locations coordinates. name Main name skip location. name_other Alternative names skip location separated commas. supervision_area Cleansing supervision area. context Type urban environment surrounding skip location. direct_access Vehicle access path type. fillup Number days fill according person surveyed. fillup_dry Number days fill dry season according person surveyed. fillup_rainy Number days fill rainy season according person surveyed. number_skips Number skips skip location. capacity Capacity one skip litres. y Y (latitude) coordinate WGS 84. x X (longitude) coordinate WGS 84. notes Notes relating skip location.
